The single loop-flavored 'familiar-made-wrong' line per pool (the last entry in playerLastFaint/foeLastFaint/fledRoad) is intentional and rationed — it should read as a passing thought, not a system message.
playerLastFaint: Last one down. No comeback left in the tank.
The bench is empty. So is the field.
Silence on your side of the field.
That's the whole team. The road waits.
Down to nothing, and nothing answers.
Whatever you came to prove, it'll have to wait.
You've stood in this exact quiet before. The thought arrives and leaves.
foeLastFaint: The last one drops. The way opens.
Nothing left across the field to answer you.
A clean win. Morning won't remember it, but you will.
You let out a breath you didn't know you were holding.
You've won this exact fight before. Somewhere. The thought passes.
fledRoad: You take the exit over the win.
Not every fight is worth the having.
The smart coward outlives the brave fool.
You walk it back the way you came. The way is shorter than it should be.
critKO: And that's the one that mattered.
Right where it had to land.
The kind of hit you only land once.
No hesitation in it. Just the drop.
